checklist: screen -ls with no sessions: 'No Sockets found in /tmp/screens.', rc 1
screen -dmS hs sleep 30: rc 0; -ls lists <pid>.hs, '1 Socket'; -S hs -X quit rc 0; -ls empty again
window fork + exec keeps the pid (slicc-kernel#176): the window's $PPID is the screen server from -ls, and /proc/<its pid> is the program
pty: screen bash --norc -i, alternate screen, echo in-$((6*7)) → in-42, exit → '[screen is terminating]', status 0

reattach from a second terminal (homescoop#162): detach in terminal A; from terminal B, the session's view of B's /dev/ttyN decides: invisible (slicc-kernel ≤ 1.30.0, #192) → screen -r does not attach and the session stays Detached (documented limit); visible → screen -r attaches ($STY set in the window), a command runs, '[screen is terminating]'
